content: v2 connection pattern is the proxy pattern: frontend never talks to the agent directly. CopilotKitProvider runtime-url points at CopilotRuntime basePath; the client discovers agents via GET /info and wraps each in an AbstractAgent proxy; agent.runAgent() -> POST /agent/:id/run -> SSE events. Alternative: CopilotKitProvider selfManagedAgents:{id: new HttpAgent({url})} (from @ag-ui/client) connects the frontend straight to a remote AG-UI endpoint without CopilotRuntime. For Railyin: runtime-url -> /api/copilotkit with custom RailyinAgentRunner in-process is the right path; HttpAgent/selfManagedAgents unnecessary.
